title: Site Header
description: The bar at the top of every page: mark, navigation, and the one action that matters.
usage: For marketing sites and app shells alike. Keep the links to five; the sixth thing you want up here is what the button is for. Below 640px the links move into a menu behind the button.
a11y: The menu button names itself (Open menu), reports aria-expanded and controls the panel. Escape closes an open menu and returns focus to the button; a pointer press outside the header or following a menu link also closes it. Focus leaving the header does not. Links and the button show the shared focus ring. Screen-reader output is not yet verified by hand.
